# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure — Rosemont Bakery & Café

**Report ID:** RB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** Tuesday, March 12, 2024
**Date of Report:** Friday, March 15, 2024
**Prepared by:** Facilities & Operations Review Team
**Distribution:** Owner, Kitchen Manager, all shift leads, refrigeration contractor

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 2:40 a.m. on March 12, the walk-in cooler at Rosemont Bakery & Café stopped maintaining temperature following a partial power interruption. The unit did not restart correctly when power returned, and the failure went undetected until the opening baker arrived at 4:15 a.m. Roughly $2,300 worth of dairy, custards, prepped fillings, and par-baked items were exposed to unsafe temperatures for an estimated 90–110 minutes. All temperature-sensitive product was discarded. No product reached customers, and no illness resulted.
